description: Run the iOS Client AI-assisted development path from brainstorming through OpenSpec artifacts, implementation, and pre-merge code review, with knowledge-base available as supporting context throughout.

dependencies.purpose: Run the pre-implementation requirement clarification and design approval gate.
dependencies.install_command: npx skills add git@git.zoom.us:ai-tools/skills.git --skill brainstorming -g -y --agent claude-code cursor codex

dependencies.purpose: Create, inspect, and apply durable OpenSpec change artifacts.
Create proposal, design/spec, and task artifacts for a new OpenSpec change.
Refine OpenSpec artifacts before implementation when design ambiguity remains.
Implement the selected OpenSpec tasks and report verification evidence.
Run iOS build, test, run, debug, log, and UI automation verification through XcodeBuildMCP with controlled DerivedData path handling.
dependencies.install_command: npx skills add git@git.zoom.us:ai-tools/skills.git --skill xcodebuildmcp-cli -g -y --agent claude-code cursor codex

dependencies.purpose: Edit Xcode project, pbxproj, target membership, build settings, and asset catalog surfaces through XcodeProjectCLI.
dependencies.install_command: npx skills add git@git.zoom.us:ai-tools/skills.git --skill manipulate-xcodeproj -g -y --agent claude-code cursor codex

dependencies.purpose: Run change-aware release QA after implementation verification and before pre-merge code review.
dependencies.install_command: npx skills add git@git.zoom.us:ai-tools/skills.git --skill agentic-release-qa -g -y --agent claude-code cursor codex

dependencies.purpose: Compare approved design, reference screenshot, or baseline image artifacts against runtime screenshots during release QA.
dependencies.install_command: npx skills add git@git.zoom.us:ai-tools/skills.git --skill pixel-diff -g -y --agent claude-code cursor codex

dependencies.purpose: Run a pre-merge code review on the current local diff or branch state before final delivery.
Collect fresh verification evidence and block completion claims until the workflow can prove it is done.
Apply Zoom iOS client review standards for memory, threading, concurrency, architecture, security, and UI-layer correctness during pre-merge review.
dependencies.install_command: npx skills add git@git.zoom.us:ai-tools/skills.git --skill ios-best-practices -g -y --agent claude-code cursor codex

dependencies.purpose: Read durable knowledge-base context during brainstorming, OpenSpec, implementation, and review stages.
dependencies.install_command: npx skills add git@git.zoom.us:ai-tools/skills.git --skill code-kb-workflow -g -y --agent claude-code cursor codex

dependencies.purpose: Evaluate development-perspective spec quality for design decisions, impact scope, and implementation readiness.
dependencies.install_command: npx skills add git@git.zoom.us:ai-tools/skills.git --skill software-design-philosophy -g -y --agent claude-code cursor codex
